facts.fact: 她接过酒瓶又放下，不肯坐着等死
facts.anchor: Sitting here and getting drunk while waiting to die was not her martial-arts style

facts.fact: 她冲动地说想吻他，他脸红，牧师抗议这是神的殿
facts.anchor: If you want, I’d kiss you

facts.fact: 她胸前有爪伤，糯米只剩六粒
facts.anchor: Six precious grains were all that remained

facts.fact: 他把母亲给的银豆护身符送给她
facts.anchor: It’s a lucky charm my mother gave me

facts.fact: 她问怎么造圣水，答案是水、十字架、牧师
facts.anchor: Water, a cross and a priest

facts.fact: 她抢过牧师的酒杯，要把酒当水用
她说要骗僵尸吃豆腐，并解释这句俗语的来历
facts.anchor: I’m going to trick them into eating tofu.

facts.fact: 牧师一本正经地说现在的年轻人爱编胡话，三人大笑
facts.anchor: Young people today do like to invent such utter balderdash.

facts.fact: 她爬上钟绳，把圣经残页贴在钟上
facts.anchor: She slapped the torn pages of the Bible onto one side of the curved bell

facts.fact: 她荡着绳子撞开僵尸，钟声让它们列队
facts.anchor: Listen, you undead bastards. Line up!

facts.fact: 他第一次把她的名字念对，她说「以后」
facts.anchor: It was the first time he had finally said her name right

facts.fact: 天快亮时，他们活了下来
facts.anchor: Against all the odds, they had survived.
